text: Never end your night without saying these four things to yourself. The last one will change the way you sleep, but first save this and send it to someone you care about. 1. Gratitude. Thank you for getting me through this day, for the lessons, for the small wins, for the strength I didn't know I had. Even in imperfect moments there was growth. 2. Reflection. Today wasn't perfect, and that's okay. If I spoke wrong, I can learn. If I failed, I can adjust. If I felt overwhelmed, I survived it. I am allowed to be human while I'm becoming better. 3. Release. I let go of what I cannot control. The conversations, replaying in my head, the pressure, the expectations, the unfinished tasks, they can wait. My peace cannot. 4. Rest and renewal. Tonight I rest without guilt. I release the need to solve tomorrow before it arrives. While I sleep, my mind resets. My body restores. My spirit strengthens. Pause. Breathe. Now rest. If this message touched you, comment, peace. And if you're ready to go deeper, I wrote something for you. The way back to stillness. It's waiting in the link on my profile. Sometimes one quiet page before bed can change the way you wake up.
